messages:
rebecca: Quick update: Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA and now rolling out. Key improvements: deterministic detokenization for tool outputs, incremental frame checksums to detect partial payloads, better client backpressure signals, and stricter arg validation for tool calls. Docs + migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/toolcall-v3

kai: Nice! timeline? do we auto-redirect old endpoints?

rebecca: Rolling region-by-region over 36h. We'll serve both /v2/toolcall and /v3 concurrently during a 30-day redirect window. Clients get a deprecation header on /v2. No auth or API key changes.

jon: Heads-up for integrators: webhook consumers will see a schema rename (payload.frames -> payload.stream_chunks) with fields: text, complete, tool_metadata. SDKs will keep the legacy shape when api_version="v2" but raw consumers must adapt. Example in docs.

nora: Ops note: we've enabled a temporary increase in burst quota for paid tool-calling customers to ease the migration spike. Please route any customer-reported throttles to #support.

rebecca: Deploys are in flight. deploy-bot: deploy started for hosted-toolcall-service eu-west-1 - build=2026.03.12-811, canary=true

kai: QA found a rare edge where long-context KV cache could drop prefix on very large consecutive tool calls. Patch merged to canary; monitoring in place.

jon: Observability: new dashboard panel in Console -> Toolcall v3 (latency, frame-error-rate, detokenization-mismatch). Alerts wired for frame checksum failures and webhook 4xx rate.

nora: Marketing will send the external blog and coordinated release notes. Rebecca can you drop a 1-2 sentence exec quote in #marketing-distro?

rebecca: Sent you a DM with a short quote. Also reminder: for high-touch accounts we will run a post-migration health check — account owners please add any custom tooling notes before EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary finished in eu-west-1, promoting to regional fleet

rebecca: Thanks team. If you run into customer-impacting regressions, escalate to @eng-oncall immediately. Otherwise we'll announce externally after full rollout completes. :tada:
